post.originalText:
Claude Opus 5.5 one-shotted this!

I asked it to create an animated explainer about the OG Postgres and this is what it came up with. 

Even used the logo elephant as a cute cartoon. 

So are YouTubers cooked or there's still hope? https://t.co/U1qnPl2diO
